evidence: Source reads, edits and manual review; cached Java/JOML class bytes decoded as data only. No Java class loading, builds, tests, syntax checks, project/game/renderer/JNI/shader/GPU execution, process inspection or exports. Runtime parity stays unverified by user instruction.

reference.projection: ProjectionType.<clinit> selects VertexSorting.DISTANCE_TO_ORIGIN at 0x07 for PERSPECTIVE and ORTHOGRAPHIC_Z at 0x1c for ORTHOGRAPHIC. vertexSorting returns that field.
reference.centroid: MeshData.decodeQuadCentroids reads Position from vertices 0 and 2. Each coordinate adds those floats then divides by float 2 (0x8f..0xa7), before CompactVectorArray.set. It does not average all four positions or use a clipped triangle's centroid.
reference.perspective: VertexSorting initializes DISTANCE_TO_ORIGIN with byDistance(0,0,0); byDistance(Vector3fc) captures that origin's distanceSquared receiver. JOML Vector3f.distanceSquared(Vector3fc) subtracts center from receiver (0x00..0x23) and returns nested Math.fma(dx,dx,Math.fma(dy,dy,dz*dz)) (0x25..0x34). The existing source profile uses JOML's default non-fused fallback; see software-model-phase-source.json for property/runtime byte evidence.
reference.orthographic: VertexSorting.lambda$static$0 reads Vector3f.z at 0x01 and negates it at 0x04; no view-matrix multiplication, camera-distance origin, perspective divide or clip-depth conversion is performed by this key function.
reference.order: VertexSorting.lambda$byDistance$0 initializes indices and calls IntArrays.mergeSort at 0x49. lambda$byDistance$1 compares keys[b] against keys[a] via Floats.compare at 0x06: stable descending float ordering, separate from the unstable whole-model sorter.

software.context: ProjectionContext privately retains the validated projection type only after its existing finite view/raw-projection/combined-matrix checks succeed. WorldFrame.copyQuadSorting requires the raster's actual cloned projection to exactly match both the current world and the captured combined matrix, plus the existing camera-relative declaration. The immutable helper is selected from that transient captured type, not mutable raw JSON fields. Missing/unvalidated context has no new key.
software.positions: JavaQuadSorting computes the original emitted 0/2 midpoint as float add/divide. Perspective uses dx*dx+(dy*dy+dz*dz) with zero-minus-centroid differences; orthographic uses unary negative centroid Z. Submitted software positions are used without additional view multiplication. This ports the key operator on its actual inputs and does not assert installed-Java/native vertex-space equivalence.
software.clipping: One boxed float key is computed for a staged original quad and shared by both 0,1,2 and 2,3,0 primitives and every resulting clipped fan triangle. Stable Collections.sort retains original primitive, clipped-piece and equal-key source order within one prepared draw. No extra geometry emission or pixel copy.
software.admission: A nullable key records unknown separately from all numeric float values. Infinity remains a numeric key, and Float.compare preserves signed-zero distinctions. Existing vertex/legacy-distance validity and geometry-budget admission are unchanged; this does not broaden overflow acceptance.
software.draws: Known checked-view skin prepared draws and compatible simple base/bent/glow prepared draws request projection-aware sorting. Every triangle in one prepared draw must carry the key; otherwise the whole draw uses the existing comparator. Solid cape/wing and selected wing glint retain their no-sortOnUpload primitive order.
software.fallback: All preview constructors, missing-projection contexts, older skin-stage fallback and abandoned/unknown phase queues retain the old Triangle.distance comparator, including the original distance/depth values. A new key on a previously staged triangle is never used by a legacy queue.

compatibility.wire: No ARCGEO, replay archive, native ABI, JNI or shader change. No new execution or verification capability is enabled.
compatibility.wholeModel: JavaModelOrder still sorts complete model submissions by its own unstable model-distance rule. This per-draw stable quad ordering does not replace model sorting or change strict/consecutive versus simple/prepared grouping.
compatibility.ownership: The captured projection is an owned software camera context, not an owning native insertion callsite, Java prepared GPU equality receipt or complete foreign world phase. Native integration remains unfinished.
